messages:
Carla_Nguyen: Quick sync — are we green to publish the joint marketplace listing + co-announce with CloudScale next Wed? Need PR, blog, landing, and SI doc handoff all timed. cc @Jen_Kim @Olivia_Martin
Dan_Patel: I thought legal was still reviewing the partner logo guidelines? any blockers from that side?
Jen_Kim: Logo pack is fine, just one small ask: remove the tertiary logo on the hero until partner clears. I'll approve the asset once updated.
Olivia_Martin: PR draft is 90% — waiting on the final quote from CloudScale and the hero image. If we get the quote by EOD Monday we can keep Wed timeline.
Priya_Singh: SI integration guide (docs) is in staging: https://redwood.internal/docs/marketplace/cloudscale-integration — need a final tech reviewer tho. Marco?
Marco_Lopez: I'll take the tech review tomorrow morning. Quick note: the onboarding script references a pipeline name that changed to `cs-deploy-prod` — I'll push a one-line update.
Carla_Nguyen: Thanks. Ops ask: can we align on exact publish times so ops can schedule CDN purge and monitoring hooks?
ops-bot: PROD deploy window available Wed 09:30-11:30 PT — schedule accepted by infra.
mktg-bot: Suggested publish cadence: press 10:00 PT (embargo lift), blog 10:15 PT, marketplace listing 10:30 PT, partner post 10:45 PT. Set reminders? :bell:
Olivia_Martin: That cadence works for editorial. PR embargo needs to be explicit: embargo lifts 10:00 PT, press copies go to our list at 09:59 with embargo watermark removed at 10:00.
Jen_Kim: Also recommend we record the contact for takedown & corrections in the release doc. I'll add legal contact line.
Dan_Patel: Ops notes — CDN purge at 09:55 PT, healthcheck smoke at 10:05 PT, alerting to #incidents if error rate > 2% in first 30m.
Priya_Singh: For SI partners we should attach the post-launch rollback playbook to the onboarding doc. I'll add a short section and link the runbook.
Marco_Lopez: Reviewed the integration guide — LGT📌. Small nit: code sample uses deprecated flag `--fast-attach`. Suggest replace with `--attach` and note compatibility.
Carla_Nguyen: Can someone paste the final asset list here so I can confirm Ops and PR have everything?
Olivia_Martin: Final assets: 1) PR draft, 2) Blog draft, 3) Landing page HTML + images, 4) Logo pack (primary + mono), 5) Partner quote, 6) SI integration guide (staging link), 7) Rollback/runbook, 8) Monitoring playbook.
Jen_Kim: I'll add the legal signoff line to PR doc once the hero logo is updated.
Dan_Patel: Ops checklist snippet for the publish (we will follow exactly):
```
- 09:45 PT: Pre-publish healthcheck (staging->prod snapshot)
- 09:55 PT: CDN purge (all static assets)
- 09:58 PT: Push landing metadata (sitemap + robots)
- 09:59 PT: PRs queued to distribution list (embargoed)
- 10:00 PT: Embargo lift + PR send
- 10:05 PT: Post-publish smoke tests
- 10:15 PT: Blog publish
- 10:30 PT: Marketplace listing live
- 10:45 PT: Partner confirm live
- 11:15 PT: Launch retrospective quick sync
```
Priya_Singh: Can we add a 5-min grace check at 10:02 to verify telemetry (latency, errors)? If >2% errors we trigger rollback.
Marco_Lopez: Agree. Also ops should collect sample API traces for first 1k requests for QA.
Carla_Nguyen: Who will be the single point to hit the distribution list at 10:00? Olivia?
Olivia_Martin: I'll own the distribution. I'll also ping our press contacts and CloudScale's PR.
Jen_Kim: Legal will be on standby for any claim questions. Phone line in the doc.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: publish-runbook @ 2216009000 (30m before).
Dan_Patel: One more request — add a small note on the landing: "Supported models and limits" section must match the marketplace listing exactly. Version numbers too.
Priya_Singh: I'll sync those fields with the listing and post a diff before EOD.
Carla_Nguyen: Perfect. If all goes well, we stick to Wed. If any of the legal/partner asset items slip, we move to backup date Fri. Please update status in the shared doc: https://redwood.internal/launchsheets/cloudscale-gTM
Marco_Lopez: I'll finish the integration docs update by 11am tomorrow and @Carla_Nguyen once done.
Olivia_Martin: I'll circulate the final PR copy for a 1-hour review window on Tue 16:00 PT. Please add comments inline. :memo:
Carla_Nguyen: Thanks team — feel free to ping here if anything changes. :rocket:
